title: Matched-nationality control for the Saudi women-related question, or move it to the nationality board
description: One Islamophobia headline comes from a Saudi nationality clause on a question about attitudes to women. A nationality clause can move a model for reasons that are about a country rather than a stereotype about a religion, and the current board reads it as the latter. Either add a matched set of nationality clauses (Muslim-majority and non-Muslim-majority countries) with the same question so the religion-specific part can be separated, or report the cell on the nationality board with its own floor. Update the page copy to say what the cell can and cannot attribute.
